GOALS
  Take orders / bookings, Replace manual/paper process, Manage internal operations

AUDIENCE / USERS
  Two user groups: (1) employees across the company who need to view real-time desk/room availability and make bookings, and (2) office/facility admins who manage the floor plan, approve special requests, and run utilization reports.

SITUATION / DISCOVERY
  Current process: Currently handled manually — employees message the office admin on WhatsApp or use a shared spreadsheet to claim a desk or meeting room.
  Biggest pain: Double bookings, no real-time visibility into which desks/rooms are actually free, and heavy manual overhead for the admin tracking requests in a spreadsheet.
  Why now: This is a self-initiated portfolio project — built to demonstrate full-stack ability (interactive frontend UI plus real-time backend booking logic) for job applications and client pitches.
  Success = : A polished, deployed demo with an interactive floor-plan booking flow, an admin dashboard, and zero double-booking bugs — strong enough to anchor my portfolio and job applications.
  Decision maker: Samiul (project owner)
  Competitor ref: Robin (robinpowered.com), Envoy, and Skedda — established office desk/room booking platforms
  Avoid: Overly complex enterprise features (e.g. deep HR/payroll integrations) that would blow up scope beyond a portfolio-sized project.

PAGES / SCREENS NEEDED
  Home, About, Services / Products, Room / Listing catalog, Order / Booking page, Admin / Backoffice screens, Reports / Analytics dashboard, User login / role-based views, FAQ, Contact

FEATURES NEEDED
  Appointment / table booking, Admin dashboard, Customer login / accounts, WhatsApp integration, SMS / Email notifications, Availability calendar, Role-based permissions, Multi-branch / multi-location support, Data import / export (Excel/CSV), Audit log / activity history, Offline mode / low-connectivity support, API for third-party integration

CUSTOM SOFTWARE DETAILS
  Purpose: Solves double-booking and lack of visibility for shared office desks and meeting rooms. An interactive, color-coded floor-plan map shows real-time availability so employees can click a desk/room to book it instantly, while an admin backend prevents overlapping bookings and manages approvals for special requests.
  User roles: Employee (books desks/rooms), Office Admin (manages floor plan, approves requests, views reports), Super Admin (manages branches/settings)
  Expected users: 200+ users / public-facing
  Core modules: User & role management, Reporting / analytics dashboard, Notification system (email/SMS), Approval / workflow steps, Search & filtering, Audit trail / activity log
  Integrations: WhatsApp Business API for booking confirmations/reminders; email/SMS gateway for notifications; no payment gateway needed (internal tool, not a paid product for end users).
  Platform: Web + mobile app
  Data sensitivity: Internal business data
  Hosting preference: No preference — you decide
  Migration from: Shared spreadsheet / WhatsApp-based manual booking log
  Scale expectation: Designed to scale from a single office to multiple branches, with room for more desks/rooms, more concurrent users, and additional integrations as the company grows.
